Why should red wine not have equal rights?

Red wine isn’t a person or a sentient being, so “equal rights” don’t apply to it in the usual legal or moral sense. It can be regulated, taxed, bought, or enjoyed—but it can’t hold rights or responsibilities.  

If you mean equal treatment compared with white wine, then there’s no good reason for discrimination: each should be judged by its quality and suitability, not its color.
